meaning: On the reading by attribution, the genus principle holds at being: from the order of being by approach to a primary (q.3 a.5 ad 2, with strict primacy) and the causal order of others to the primary (q.13 a.5), by excluded middle. Only the instance at being is derived. Omission countermodels (in the Solution) show that the causal order and strict primacy are each needed.
